messages:
Alina: Heads-up — FinServe wants a Private VPC POC sizing/proforma they can approve by EOW.
Alina: TL;DR they want a 30-day POC with steady traffic ~12 QPS, weekday peaks to ~60 QPS, workload = mixed (embeddings + text-gen). Target p95 gen latency <300ms, embeddings <150ms.
Ben: What models & quantization? that drives GPU choices.
Alina: Plan: generator = Llama-13B 4-bit-optimized (runtime build), embeddings = small-embed-2. Gen will be streaming, avg gen payload ~1.2k tokens; embed ~512 tokens.
Chao: Quick note — latency numbers at 60 QPS will need pooling/batching & headroom. Without batching, 13B on a single A100 saturates at lower concurrency for p95 targets.
Ben: Can you throw the B.O.E. GPU-hour calc here? I want to include it in the proforma slide.
Alina: Pasting a small calc (very simplified):
```
# rough monthly GPU-hour calc (example)
seconds_per_month = 30 * 24 * 3600
steady_qps = 12
peak_qps = 60
gen_fraction = 0.30
embed_fraction = 0.70
avg_tokens_gen = 1200
# measured tokens/s per A100 for 13B 4-bit in our runtime (approx):
tokens_per_gpu_sec = 8000

# monthly tokens for gen (steady)
gen_tokens_month = steady_qps * gen_fraction * avg_tokens_gen * seconds_per_month
# gpu-hours for gen
gpu_hours_gen = gen_tokens_month / (tokens_per_gpu_sec * 3600)

# embed load handled by T4-like cards; estimate embed_qps = steady_qps * embed_fraction
# embed_gpu_hours = embed_qps * seconds_per_month / (embed_throughput_per_gpu * 3600)
```
Alina: With those numbers, ballpark comes to ~1k GPU-hours/month of A100-equivalent for steady baseline; add ~20–30% for peaks/bursty weekdays => plan 1.3k A100-hours reserved for POC. Embedding pool ~1.4k T4-hours (two T4s 24/7 for a month in our baseline).
Chao: Suggested physical layout for the POC (min viable):
- 2 x A100-80GB (gen pool) for redundancy + rolling upgrades
- 2 x T4 (embed pool) or 1x T4 + 1x smaller GPU if customer wants cost-savings
- 1 control node (CPU-heavy, for routing, k8s control plane, model management)
- 20% spare capacity on gen pool for bursts and canary rollouts
Marta: Networking constraints to flag to FinServe: their VPC has 1Gbps egress per subnet; model downloads during cache warmup can saturate that. Recommend model edge-caching + pre-pull to local NVMe.
Marta: Also recommend separate subnets for inference vs evaluation traffic, and explicit NACL rules for model registry + KMS.
ops-bot: Created checklist: [x] subnet plan, [x] KMS key, [x] firewall rules, [x] model cache NVMe, [ ] perf test runbook, [ ] monitoring dashboards
Sam: Cost-ish equivalence (cloud-list-rate rough): 2x A100 + 2x T4 running 30d => A100-hours = 2*720=1440, T4-hours=2*720=1440. If cloud-rate A100~$3/hr, T4~$0.8/hr -> (~$4.3k + $1.15k) ≈ $5.5k/month. Use only as a rough procurement anchor for customer.
Ben: Good, please add a conservative 20% contingency for model-version risk and extra perf overhead in the slide.
Alina: Will run the perf POC next Tue to validate tokens/s numbers and update the proforma. I'll also ask infra to verify customer's subnet egress cap before we finalize.
Chao: If perf shows lower tokens/sec we can suggest a hybrid option: 1 larger gen card (A100) + 1 mid-size (A30) to smooth cost.
Ben: Thanks — this is enough to build the POC deck. I'll draft slides and tag SRE for the runbook. :thumbsup:
Alina: tagging @Marta for networking sign-off and @Chao for infra procurement guidance. Thanks everyone.
